messages.subject: digitize2D and digit.curves
parts:
I know I can use digitize2D to place a series of landmarks along a curve/curves, but I'm bad at getting the R syntax correct.

Say I have 100 landmarks: 20 define curve1, 40 define curve 2, 40 define curve3. I know how to use digit.curves to get the start/end and evenly spaced coords for each segment. 

Assuming I have 50 images, all with the same landmarks defining the same curves etc., how would I batch process all of them at the same time? I know I'd read in my TPS file, but how to go from 100 raw LMs to the three sets of spaced LMs with all specimens in a single tps file.

Thanks in advance!
Russ

messages.author: 4d71c6e24fb21497
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] digitize2D and digit.curves
parts:
I might suggest the r package StereoMorph. It has 2d curve capabilities that are really useful. One firs a curve and then post hoc can decide how many points to extract from it.

Dean

Dean
